product_metadata.title: Big Joe Bean Refill Polystyrene Beans for Bean Bags or Crafts, 100 Liters
features: IT'S THE INSIDE THAT MATTERS: Give your bean chair or pool float some love with Big Joe rejuvenating polystyrene beans; They are lightweight and 100% recyclable!
EASY TO REFILL: Cut along the provided dotted line of the refill bag and simply pour
BRING YOUR BIG JOE BACK TO LIFE: For an approximate amount to refill, a small chair or pool float may need 2-3 bags; While larger ones may need 3-4
HOME GROWN: Popped right here in the USA
description: After you've given your bean chair or pool float some love, it may look like it needs a pick-me-up! When it does start to slouch, our bean refill packs are here for you. Each pack contains 100 liters of fresh new beans. Detailed instructions on bean replacement can be found on the warning label attached to your Big Joe's cover. They are also ideal for packing, arts and crafts, DIY projects, you name it!
